item.title: 25k gallons of wastewater released in creek in Seneca
item.description: OCONEE COUNTY, S.C. (WSPA) - Oconee Joint Regional Sewer Authority (OJRSA) said approximately 25,000 gallons of wastewater was released into a nearby creek following a wastewater main break. item.description: SENECA, S.C. (WSPA) - The Oconee County Coroner's Office said a man died Wednesday evening after slipping on an ice patch outside of his home.
